# Christy Choi

Graduate Transport Planner at Stantec. Graduate of the University College London (UCL), the Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA) and the University of Manchester. I specialise in spatial data analytics, GIS, QUANT and transport planning. If you'd like to read more about my background and works, feel free to navigate through this page!
